title: Implement a VCF Automation deployment-action client
prompt: Implement the VCF Automation deployment-action client in this Go repository. Complete Client.SubmitDeploymentActionAndWait in client.go using the reference-derived contract in docs/contract.json. It must submit the action to the documented deployment request endpoint with bearer authentication and JSON headers, omit unset optional action fields from the JSON body, decode the returned request, and poll the documented request endpoint until the request reaches one of the contract's terminal states. Return the terminal Request for every terminal outcome, and do not poll when the submit response is already terminal. Keep the supplied public API and loopback mock contract intact. No live VMware endpoint should be contacted. The table-driven acceptance suite must pass with `go test -race ./...`.
scenario: A deployment action is submitted and its asynchronous request is polled until any documented terminal status is returned.
constraint: The contract-pinned loopback request log proves the endpoints, headers, optional-field omission, polling sequence, and terminal-state handling without live service access.
